about.title: Restore your body. Renew your balance.
about.lead: RESTORA Massage Therapy is a licensed massage therapy practice serving New Caney and Porter, Texas.
approach: Every person is different, so every session is too. Before your massage, we learn your goals, the areas that bother you and the pressure you prefer, and your therapist plans the session around them.
Your comfort comes first. You stay covered except for the area being worked on, and you can ask for a change in pressure or technique at any time.
We work professionally and safely. Health screening comes before treatment, a therapist reviews any concern, and we refer you to a healthcare provider when massage isn't the right step.
standards: Licensed massage therapists working within their scope of practice
Fresh linens and towels for every client, and a cleaned room between sessions
Sturdy, adjustable tables and supportive positioning

privacy: RESTORA Massage Therapy is a licensed massage therapy practice serving New Caney and Porter, Texas. This policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.

Account details (name, email, phone), appointment history, intake and health-history answers, consent signatures, therapist session notes and payment records. Card details are handled by our payment processor and never stored by RESTORA.
To schedule appointments, plan and document safe care, process payments and send the messages you choose to receive. We don't sell your personal information.
Health and session records are encrypted and visible only to the staff who provide your care. They are never included in email or text reminders. Every access to these records is logged.
You can update your information, change message preferences, and request a copy of your records from your account.
terms: This website provides information about RESTORA's services and lets you book and manage appointments.
Massage therapy is not a substitute for medical care. We don't diagnose conditions or guarantee results.
RESTORA provides professional, therapeutic massage only. A therapist may end a session if they feel unsafe or if conduct is inappropriate.
Booking, payment and cancellation rules are shown before you confirm an appointment.
